propositions: Commit 40b8ac8295 eagerly activates runtime.py on every bridge pass, but runtime.py unconditionally imports pydantic.SecretStr at module scope while the bridge installs core without [agents] extra, causing ModuleNotFoundError on scheduled passes

The reconciler engine is documented as stdlib-only and must remain importable without Pydantic, but the credential carrier StaticAuth requires masking/reveal semantics that the repair must preserve using only stdlib primitives
The clean-runtime subprocess oracle test must load the real packaged reconciler and reject Pydantic at import time, proving the contract cannot regress under CI
Repair replaces Pydantic SecretStr with a frozen stdlib string field, keeping reveal() available only at existing Cloud/DC authentication boundaries
